text:
Carmen: Astra Cloud asked for a joint marketplace feature + webinar + short benchmark blog. We should treat this as a small sprint (3 weeks). Who volunteers for owners?

Diego: I can own marketplace listing and partner liaison. Need Astra logos (SVG + PNG), 1x hero image, 2-sentence product blurb, and a 60s demo. Prefer launch week of June 9.

Alex (Astra): Confirmed. Astra will share logos and a co-branded hero by June 1. We can also promote the webinar in our partner digest.

Rina: I'll run the benchmark blog and the technical how-to. Plan: include latency and cost delta for prefix-heavy chat and an honest methodology section. Need perf outputs and sample prompts.

ops-bot: Marketplace checklist posted: assets, 60s video, legal signoff, UTM tags. Refer to /ops/templates/marketplace-ready.

Kevin: I'll own webinar ops + landing page. Proposed slot: Thu June 11, 9am PT. Format: 20m demo, 25m joint Q&A + customer story snippet. Need speakers list.

Mktg-Design: Can do hero and social cards. Need the copy ASAP. Also can help edit the 60s video.

Carmen: Two priority asks: (1) a short AE playbook (one page) with top objections and product fallbacks, (2) lead routing mapping so ops can auto-tag marketplace leads.

Diego: For lead routing, propose this mapping (ops, please implement):

```
source=partner_marketplace
partner=astra_cloud
campaign=astra_marketplace_jun2026
sfdc_owner=Partner_Ops
lead_queue=partners_astra
utm_source=astra_marketplace&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=astra_marketplace_jun2026
```

Rina: On benchmarks 1: I'll run three scenarios: base (no caching), Redwood caching+batching, Redwood+edge routing via Astra. Expect to publish a transparent methodology note. Will post results by Tue EOD.

Kevin: Promo cadence: announcement (2wks), reminder 1wk, reminder 2d, day-of. I can draft email series and 3 social posts (announcement, technical highlight, webinar CTA).

Alex (Astra): Astra can provide a short customer quote and help with newsletter amplification. Legal will need to sign off on any customer quotes.

Carmen: Action items recap:
- Diego: marketplace listing + partner comms (owner)
- Rina: benchmark blog + methodology (owner)
- Kevin: webinar ops + landing page + email series (owner)
- Mktg-Design: hero + social pack + video edit (owner)
- Alex (Astra): co-branded assets + customer quote (partner)

Carmen: Please report blockers here. If none, we'll lock dates and open a short Asana sprint. Also tag Legal for the quote approvals. :tada:
